stories.title: Man dead after being shot on near north side of Indianapolis
stories.summary: The shooting happened around 11:45 p.m. on Tuesday near the 3300 block of North Meridian Street.

stories.title: IMPD: Person in critical condition after shooting on Indy's near east side
stories.summary: The shooting happened around 12:20 a.m. near the intersection of Dorman and East New York streets.

stories.title: Statewide Silver Alert canceled for missing 84-year-old man from Michigan
stories.summary: The man was last seen Monday, Nov. 16 and was missing from Macomb Township, Michigan.

stories.title: Silver Alert canceled for woman missing from Munster
stories.summary: State police canceled a Silver Alert for a 71-year-old woman who was reported missing from Lake County Tuesday.

stories.title: Inside Indiana's fight against child sex crimes
stories.summary: Across Indiana, law enforcement officials are confronting a growing challenge: how to keep pace with child predators operating in an increasingly digital world.

stories.title: Hundreds fill Statehouse for rally to protect services for Hoosiers with disabilities
stories.summary: Hoosiers with disabilities, along with their families and advocates, filled the Statehouse to urge lawmakers to fund and protect Home and Community-Based Services.

stories.title: ISP investigating death of incarcerated person who got out of moving transport van
stories.summary: The individual reportedly got out of a moving transport vehicle that was going to the Miami Correctional Facility Monday evening.

stories.title: Indianapolis man convicted of murder in 2024 hit-and-run in bar parking lot
stories.summary: Felipe Maguellal was found guilty of killing 40-year-old Perry Banks with his SUV outside a bar on West Morris Street on Oct. 19, 2024.

stories.title: Former Tech High School student takes plea deal in stabbing murder of classmate
stories.summary: Jeury Aburto Guzman and the girl he killed were both 14 years old at the time of the crime near the school campus.

stories.title: Hoosier, 97, has connection to history-making SS United States
stories.summary: Seventy-four years before the ship was sunk to become the world's largest artificial reef, it set a transatlantic speed record that still stands today.

stories.title: IPS proposes closing 6 school buildings, merging several schools in restructuring plan
stories.summary: District leaders said the proposal would save about $4 million while addressing declining enrollment and ongoing financial challenges.

stories.title: Garten files for recount after Indiana Supreme Court clears the way for him to take office
stories.summary: The Indiana Supreme Court allowed Garten to take office, but stopped short of certifying the results of his election.
